regression_closures.evidence: New original views independently show split double-page wording/diagrams only for automatic RTL spread; single and vertical show unsplit single-page wording/diagrams and one-page folios. No old closure was adopted and no wider regression closure is claimed.

limitations: Only the three assigned current C7 originals were reviewed. Legacy c5 identifiers identify current cases and contracts; no old candidate or report served as this round visual evidence.
All identities are owner declarations. The immutable module inventory and gate-manifest SHA bind this batch; the owner declares the full-round manifest pending.
All three cases lack an independent exact landscape-orientation export. References were opened as related contracts only; no exact pixel or stretch-profile equivalence is claimed.

Candidates were opened at their native 1240x930 capture size. The original physical references are factor two; view_image displayed the landscape references at 1824x1368 and portrait reference at 1368x1824. No worker crop, scaling, image processing or necessary unreadable-detail gap arose.

Scribe metadata describes the desktop profile and software landscape rotation. Physical hardware and hardware dither remain unqualified; these screenshots cannot establish physical rotation/input, e-ink behavior, lifecycle/cold behavior or a genuine live-reader lease.

Closed-reader art-only and valid odd-final span1 remain the contract, but these open orientation-sheet cases do not independently qualify those states. No full-round completion or clean-round claim is made.
